subject: Brightlane: eval on-ramp, artifact safeguards, and pilot close cadence
messages:
From: Tom Calder <tom@brightlane.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com
Cc: sara@brightlane.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot materials and timeframe

Chloe,

Appreciate the quick demo yesterday. We've prepared a slightly expanded sample set and a short pilot spec to accelerate validation. High level: 2-week pilot to verify quality and throughput across your hosted variants, then decide on Dedicated.

What we'll send: a 500-record probe set (sanitized), a prompt pack with 120 test cases, and a tiny test harness (python). Constraints: evaluation-only; no public benchmarking.

Attachments: Brightlane_probe_v2.tar, pilot_spec_v1.pdf

Can Redwood propose a concise MAP that captures acceptance gates, artifact handling, and a close date? We want to avoid long tail negotiations.

Tom Calder
Head of ML Engineering, Brightlane Analytics
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Calder <tom@brightlane.com>, Sara Vega <sara@brightlane.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot materials and timeframe

Tom / Sara,

Thanks 2D concise is good. Draft MAP below (compact) focused on artifact exchange, usage constraints, and a firm close cadence. We've attached Redwood_Brightlane_MAP_v0.2.xlsx with owners and sign-off cells.

Compact MAP (proposed)
- Day 0 (today): Redwood confirms acceptable artifact formats and returns MAP v0.2 for signature.
- Day 12D2: Brightlane uploads prompt pack + probe set to the shared ingest folder.
- Day 32D9: Redwood runs evaluation across agreed variants and collects per-case diffs + cost/latency metrics.
- Day 102D11: Brightlane review and QA; return acceptance comments (or a prioritized bug list).
- Day 12: Final acceptance sign-off or three-way decision to extend by up to 5 working days.

Artifact handling & usage constraints (summary)
- Purpose: evaluation-only; artifacts not to be used for benchmarking or model training.
- Non-redistribution: Brightlane artifacts may only be accessed by Redwood evaluation engineers and named Brightlane reviewers.
- Ephemeral storage: artifacts mounted to ephemeral instances; shredded within 30 days of final sign-off unless an extension is mutually executed.
- Derivative outputs: Redwood may share evaluation outputs (CSV diffs, aggregated metrics) but not raw input records.
- Auditability: Redwood will provide an audit log of accesses tied to the MAP period.

Deliverables from Redwood
- Per-prompt diff CSV and a short findings memo.
- Token-level cost and latency dashboard link.
- Ingest manifest confirmation and a ZIP of any test harness used.

Next actions: Marissa will confirm ingestion format and token TTLs. If the MAP looks good, Tom please request a DocuSign link and we'll prepare the ingest folder.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Calder <tom@brightlane.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot materials and timeframe 

On Wed, Jun 3, 2026 at 11:02 AM Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Next actions: Marissa will confirm ingestion format and token TTLs.

Technical packaging notes from Redwood (please review)
1) Preferred prompt pack layout:
- Root ZIP with promptpack.jsonl (one JSON line per test case). Required fields: test_id, prompt_text, expected_tags. Optional: media/ for assets. Include README.md with canonical train/test split and deterministic RNG seed.
- Provide a manifest.csv (SHA256 hashes for each file) so we can verify integrity on ingest.

2) Ingestion & sandbox TTLs
- Default sandbox token TTL = 10 days. We can grant a one-time single extension of up to 7 days if agreed prior to expiry.
- Audit logs for accesses will be retained for 90 days; ephemeral instance logs purged after 48 hours unless escalated for an incident.

3) Models & eval harness
- We'll run the pack on r-instruct-small, r-instruct-medium, and r-instruct-large. Please avoid model-specific tokens.
- If you have a test harness, include a lightweight wrapper; we will not run arbitrary binaries.

4) Security & data handling
- Artifacts are mounted read-only to ephemeral VMs; no snapshots.
- We will not use artifacts to train or improve public models; this is contractual.

Deliverables we will upload back to the shared folder:
- diffs_per_case.csv, summary_metrics.csv, redwood_evaluation_readme.md, and a redacted example trace for debugging.

Attachments: prompt_schema.md, ingestion_script_example.py

If this looks OK, we'll prepare the ingest folder and request the upload by Monday.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Calder <tom@brightlane.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Vega <sara@brightlane.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot materials and timeframe

Marissa / Chloe,

Thanks 2D packaging guidance looks good. A couple of clarifications from Brightlane's side before we sign:
1) Token rotation: can Redwood rotate sandbox tokens every 72 hours during the ingest window and provide the rotation schedule? We prefer short-lived credentials.
2) Logs: fine with 90-day audit retention for access logs, but we require that any ephemeral instance stdout/stderr be retained only for 48 hours except when explicitly escalated. Please add that as an MAP bullet.
3) Non-usage clause: please add a line that Redwood will not use the artifacts or outputs in public benchmark comparisons or for marketing without explicit written consent.

If you add these bullets to the MAP we'll sign. We'll plan to upload the prompt pack Tuesday morning.

Tom
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Calder <tom@brightlane.com>, Sara Vega <sara@brightlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot materials and timeframe 

Tom / Sara,

All good 2D we've updated the MAP with your three bullets (token rotation every 72 hours during ingest, ephemeral stdout/stderr 48-hour retention unless escalated, and a strict non-usage/public benchmark clause). Attached: Redwood_Brightlane_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (signed-ready).

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/EXAMPLE-BL-MAP-8821
Ingest folder (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Brightlane-Temp-Ingest

Please sign the MAP and upload the prompt pack to the folder. We'll provision rotating tokens tomorrow morning and confirm with a short note when the sandbox is live. Happy to fast-follow if you need additional guardrails.

Chloe Martin
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
